title: Unmask
summary: UNM'ASK, verb transitive To strip of a mask or of any disguise; to lay open what is concealed. UNM'ASK, verb intransitive To put off a mask.

inlines.v: UNM'ASK, verb transitive To strip of a mask or of any disguise; to lay open what is concealed. UNM'ASK, verb intransitive To put off a mask.
